name: viverse-polygon-streaming-playcanvas
description: Runtime Polygon Streaming .xrg integration for PlayCanvas apps built on @polygon-streaming/web-player-playcanvas: script-component setup (streamController/streamableModel), automatic service-worker registration vs manual file publishing, Ammo/Basis WASM prerequisites for embedded colliders and KTX2 textures, and entity-level load/error/animation events.
prerequisites: Ability to publish files at the app web root
